_what: Step b of the Commons' curation order: each college's local subject codes, from its printed catalog (kb/hand_filed_catalogs/courses/) beside the state list (coci_lookup_data.js). printed_name is the catalog's subject heading and the draft local subject title (owner: the Courses bot, state: drafted); null reads TBA. side says who prints the code: both, catalog (the catalog only) or state (the state list only). The codes on one side only are the curator's list. common is the common subject code (Step a) where the subject map and the canonical SUBJ give one. Built by kb/_build_local_subject_titles.py; no clock is read, so read_at is each catalog's own.
_rule: A catalog's subject code and the state list's are the same code when they are equal after trimming and upper-casing; nothing looser. A college is the same college when its names are equal after lower-casing and folding every run of other characters to one space (Los Angeles Trade-Technical College is Los Angeles Trade Technical College). The common subject code is read from the subject map (its keys: upper case, letters and digits only) and the discipline's canonical SUBJ; where either has nothing, it is blank. A TOP code is never read.

draft.settled_by: a curator, for the codes that disagree
